name: Tide In and Out
description: Six slow rounds of a long in-breath and a longer out-breath, like a tide.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Six easy rounds, each a long in-breath and a longer out-breath, on Breathing Space.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Stop after any round.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in as the shape swells, like a wave coming up the shore.
Breathe out as it draws back. Follow the words if they help.
tips: Breathe only as deeply as feels easy. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
